current.text: Milwaukee got him in the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade. He is set to start, and his role is settled.
He is probably the best player on the Bucks and should be their leading scorer and main creator. He was Miami's top offensive option, so the trade does not change much for him.
He is on an expiring 33 million USD contract.

He could be traded again. Justin expects him to stay until at least the trade deadline, where he could be moved because Burries is the long-term shooting guard. The roster needs trades to consolidate, and Herro is one of the players who do not fit well.
Milwaukee's guard group is crowded, with Rollins, Porter, Jakucionis, Burries, Trent and Green. Herro, Rollins and Porter will compete for creation. Herro will not play point guard.
Guard depth, plus a focus on developing young players that should grow as the season goes on, may keep his minutes below 34 to 35.
He missed many games with injuries last season. Even so, he finished around 53rd to 56th in 9-cat.
Durability is a concern after last season's missed games.
If he plays 35 minutes, he would be a top 35 player.

Experts disagree on his price. Most call an ADP of 58 to 70 fair or a strong pick in round 6, and they say his production in Milwaukee is relatively safe. The newest note says rank 56 in ESPN points leagues may be his best case and calls that slightly scary.
Milwaukee has a new coach, Taylor Jenkins, who might use a deep rotation. Experts expect the Bucks to be bad: their win total is 26.5, and Justin expects about 33 wins.
Milwaukee plays 334 games through March 28 and has 14 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is an elite free throw shooter and a decent passer.
He has a long injury history that could come back.

note: Herro's 9-cat line is strong: projected 89% FT on good volume, 3.0 threes and 23 points, with no weak category. That makes him an easy fit in any build. Both sites rank him around 65 to 68, and he went for 14 USD in our league last season. Paying about 14 to 16 USD (Yahoo value 16) is fair, and anything near ESPN's 7 USD is a bargain. Early in the season, check whether he plays about 34 minutes in the crowded Bucks backcourt and how healthy he stays, and plan for trade talk before the March 4 deadline.
